summary.text: Val Winn, listed by Ballotpedia as Valdenia Winn, is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 34 since 2001 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. She is a former professor at Kansas City Community College and has served on the Kansas City, Kansas Public Schools Board of Education since 2015.

paragraphs.text: Winn earned a bachelor's degree in secondary education, a master's degree in history and a Ph.D. in history from the University of Kansas.
Her professional experience includes working as a professor at Kansas City Community College.
Winn assumed office in the Kansas House in 2001 and won election to an at-large seat on the Kansas City, Kansas Public Schools Board of Education in April 2015.

During the 2025-2026 session she served on the Financial Institutions and Pensions, House Education, Administrative Rules and Regulations, and Legislative Post Audit committees, and as ranking minority member of the K-12 Education Budget Committee.
According to Ballotpedia, Winn is chairman and treasurer of the Northeast Coalition, treasurer of the Northeast Cooperative Council, and a member of the Governor's Council on Travel & Tourism.
